```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 06_probability_catan
title: >
  Commit to a corner
questions:
  - id: catan_settlement
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      Which corner did you pick, and what made it look good? Name it by the
      numbers it touches — the 5-6-9 corner, the 3-8-10 corner, and so on.
    answer: >
      Any corner, so long as you can say what you were going for. Most people
      look for the red 6s and 8s, because the game itself flags those as the
      numbers that come up most often.
    explanation: >
      We are deliberately not settling this yet. Hold on to your choice: once we
      have counted the ways two dice can land, we will be able to work out
      the probability that any corner on this board pays out, and you can see
      how your instinct did.
```
